_doc: Daily life in the base (GDD §4 'daily life of survivors', 1.7 step 2). Every hour each survivor not on a mission scores what they could do and does the best: score = own need x the base's need x traits (GDD). Sequential in id order, so a room already taken this hour scores lower for the next person (crowding). Curves are [[x, y], ...] points, linear between. Every number here is Claude's.

night.note: sleep pulls hardest in these hours; Night Owl sleeps late and works late

evening.note: people gather and read after work

note_stick: stick: a bonus for going on with what they did last hour, so nobody flips every hour. jitter: up to this much random per option, so two alike survivors don't move in step

sleep.note: once asleep they sleep until fatigue is under wake_below. Hurt or sick sleepers get an infirmary bed first

rest.note: heavily hurt, sick or quarantined: rest by day (the infirmary), sleep by night; nothing else

work.note: a room's need: building = build; a queued job that can run = job_floor..1 by how short the base is of its output (stock_want); a watchtower with a free guard post = watch. Split by 1 + crowding x people already there this hour. A survivor whose community skill fits the room (room_skill) x(1 + skill_match). Assigned by the player (Survivor.assignment) = pinned: works only there, x(1 + pinned). After shift_hours of work today (Workhorse: shift_length) x after_shift

read.note: reading a book (Survivor.reading) or, with books on the shelf, browsing: Wits XP. Books still finish by days (CommunityRules)

exercise.note: push-ups on the roof: a quarter of a fitness corner's XP (the corner is a room for later)

socialise.note: talk, eat together; round the kitchen's fire (any kitchen) it pulls harder and cheers twice as much

idle.note: small jobs that make the base look alive: hang washing, water plants

trait_weights.note: an activity id or a room id (work in that room); multiplied together
